rows.quote: The GWAS summary statistics for AAA based on the AAAgen Consortium can be accessed at https://csg.sph.umich.edu/willer/public/AAAgen2023/.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the AAAgen Consortium AAA GWAS summary statistics and their download location (AAAgen2023); p002 cites them to reference 4 (Roychowdhury 2023, DOI 10.1038/s41588-023-01510-y) with 37 214 cases and 1 086 107 controls; the dictionary has no row for an abdominal aortic aneurysm GWAS and none with that DOI.

rows.quote: We used the latest release data on AAA from the FinnGen study R10 in this analysis, which comprised 3869 cases and 381 977 controls.
rows.coder_note: The sentence writes 'FinnGen study R10' (rule A), in agreement with the r10.finngen.fi address two sentences earlier; the endpoint counts 3869/381 977 are not a release N (rule H) and nothing conflicts.

Reference 13 (Sun 2023, DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6) is verified but is the source of four UKB-PPP rows; the passages give 2923 proteins on Olink Explore 3072, common to those rows, and a cohort of 54 219 participants, which equals no row's sample size and so neither separates the rows (rule E) nor exactly identifies another release (rule H); no subcohort or ancestry is stated.

In p003 the attribution sentence cites deCODE Genetics to reference 14, which is Pietzner 2021 (DOI 10.1126/science.abj1541), the source identifier of the Fenland SomaScan v4 row, while the description two sentences later (4907 proteins, 35 559 individuals, SOMAscan version 4) is the exact N and platform of the Ferkingstad 2021 row; the reference entry and the sentence identify different dictionary rows, so the row is unresolved for adjudication.
